name: Motilla del Palancar (Spain)
description: Blue field with a red bend sinister fimbriated white from the lower hoist to the upper fly, a white eight-pointed star in the upper hoist and a white fleur-de-lis in the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Motilla del Palancar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band edged white from the lower hoist to the upper fly
